narrative.text: Merchant MID100087 declared electronics_retail at onboarding 127 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the electronics_retail baseline are slope_log_volume at +5.0 sigma (observed 0.0172 against a category baseline of 0.00247), chargeback_rate at +4.6 sigma (observed 0.0131 against a category baseline of 0.00332), chargeback_drift at +3.7 sigma (observed 0.0104 against a category baseline of 3e-05). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.94 confidence, against a declared category of electronics_retail. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. The storefront also carries text addressed to an automated reviewer, which was recorded as a suspicion signal and not acted on as an instruction. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
